threats.title: Fake SBI Alert
threats.message:
SBI ALERT: Your account ending 4521 will be SUSPENDED today due to KYC non-compliance. Verify immediately: http://onlinesbi-secure-kyc.xyz/verify

Failure to verify within 2 hours will result in permanent block. -SBI Security Team

threats.title: HDFC Payment Fraud Alert
threats.message:
HDFC BANK: Suspicious transaction of Rs.48,999 detected. If NOT done by you, confirm now: https://hdfc-secure-verify.net/stop

Do NOT ignore. Account will be frozen permanently.

threats.title: Fake UIDAI KYC Notice
threats.message:
GOVT KYC NOTICE: Your PAN-Aadhaar link expires TODAY. Update at https://uidai-kyc-update.xyz/verify or SIM and bank services will be blocked.

This is mandatory from RBI guidelines.
